limits: Replays complete timing/control journals, frozen requests, decisions, and practical gates without a board or models.
Raw output tensors and neural models are omitted; recorded tensor hashes and private numerical-audit reports are retained, not independently recomputed here.
Recorded two-sweep controls are point-in-time evidence, not continuous NPU ownership or independent historical authentication.
Hashes detect changes relative to this package; they do not prove historical timestamps, preregistration, or truthful execution.
No inference of statistical significance, novelty, cross-vendor generality, or acceptance probability.

conditional_amortization.interpretation: Conditional on repeating this workload after one initialization; uses mean of two session preparations. Total charged-preparation illustration, not incremental setup versus calibrated fixed planners. Calibration/qualification service excludes control/archival/warm-up wall time, export/compilation and runtime/model initialization; not total deployment cost.

limits: No coefficient refitting or additional acceptance gate.
Prediction boundary excludes common fallback, planning, decision and loop gaps.
Measured best fixed per mask is a hindsight oracle from separate noisy executions, not a counterfactual.
Measured choice penalty compares the chosen fixed configuration with the hindsight best; separately timed chooser cost can differ through decision work and ordinary timing variation.
Additional normalization-choice rules are offline descriptive choices over fixed measurements, not separately timed deployed policies; their decision overhead is not measured.
Preparation serialized bytes are not resident memory.
